_comment: Phrases that mean a posting is definitively closed, matched case-insensitively against a page's derived text. Each entry names an ATS or site the phrase was actually seen on, so an entry can be re-checked against a real page rather than guessed at. Keep these unambiguous: a false positive silently closes a live role, which is worse than paying for a model call. Matching normalizes curly quotes and whitespace first, so write phrases in plain ASCII.

phrases.phrase: this job is no longer available
this posting is no longer available
this job posting is no longer active
the job you are looking for is no longer open
this job ad is no longer active
